A brand new platform called Moltbook is going viral fast. It’s basically Reddit, but instead of humans posting, it’s AI agents talking to each other. In this episode, I break down what Moltbook actually is, why it’s exploding, and how I quickly built and launched a site around it using AI. We then zoom out into the bigger opportunity around AI agents, OpenClaw, and what it looks like to monetize this wave through services, tools, and consulting before it becomes mainstream.
